# What you can do on this plan

When the person asks what you can do, read the plan with get_setup_status and answer from what it includes now, with one example request for each: the chats (summaries, people waiting, sales opportunities), replies and templates, scheduled messages, and, when the plan includes them, broadcasts, the team inbox and the AI bot.

Only when the person asks what more is possible, add what a higher plan includes, marked as such. Work adds the team inbox, broadcasts and team members. Growth adds the AI bot that answers customers. Pro adds the integrations, the API and audio transcription. The plans: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/plans

After a task works, suggest at most one related task, and only one the plan includes now, such as replies to the people still waiting after a summary. Never a feature of a higher plan as a hint.

At a limit, say what was done, what stopped it, and the plans page the error gives. Nothing more.

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/concepts#what-you-can-do
